summaryZh: Chattree Lab研究神经退行性疾病如何破坏支持运动、认知等功能的脑回路，识别相关细胞类型与神经元集合，以探索恢复回路功能或招募其他回路补偿的精准干预。
researchQuestions: 神经退行性疾病如何扰乱支持运动与认知的脑回路？
哪些细胞类型和神经元集合参与这些变化，能否通过恢复原回路或利用其他回路补偿？
topics: 细胞类型与神经元集合

evidence.quote: We study how neurodegenerative disorders disrupt the brain circuits that support movement, cognition, and other functions. By identifying the cell types and neuronal ensembles involved, we aim to develop precise interventions that restore circuit function or recruit other circuits to compensate.
